subject.title: feat(memory): add excludePaths option to memorySearch config

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a permanent builtin-only `memorySearch.excludePaths` public configuration contract while QMD intentionally ignores the setting?
rationale: The change adds a new persisted user-facing option and documents backend-divergent behavior; that product boundary cannot be settled mechanically.

options.title: Sponsor the builtin-only option
options.body: Approve the documented backend scope, then require the CodeQL exemption to be narrowed and the direct dependency change to be authorized.

options.title: Choose a different ownership boundary
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want path-exclusion policy owned by a different memory/plugin surface or require parity with QMD first.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the builtin-only option
recommendation.body: Approve the documented backend scope, then require the CodeQL exemption to be narrowed and the direct dependency change to be authorized.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent work identifies the same memory-core area, although direct ownership history could not be inspected.
